intro: Grow the goods and rule the retail market!
description:
Who knew that a successful business could start in a tomato garden? Your day begins with harvesting ripe tomatoes and carrying them directly to your shelves. But tomatoes are only the beginning. To satisfy your hungry customers, you must feed those tomatoes to your backyard hens and gather fresh eggs to stock the adjacent display.

This is a fast-paced game of supply and demand that requires perfect balance. You must constantly run between your harvesting patches, animal feeding pens, retail shelves, and the busy checkout counter. As you accumulate cash, you can expand your store, unlock new inventory types, and hire clerks and cashiers to automate the daily grind. Keep your shelves full, your chickens fed, and your checkout lines moving quickly to build the ultimate community market.

Key Features:
• Farming Meets Retail: Harvest fresh tomatoes from your garden and use them to feed your chickens, which will produce high-demand eggs.
• Hands-On Management: Move quickly between production stations, stock shelves to the brim, and process payments at the cash register.
• Expand and upgrade: Use your profits to unlock new sections of your market, increase your carrying capacity, and boost your movement speed.
• Assemble your staff. Hire and train helpful employees to stock shelves and manage the checkout line, allowing you to focus on expanding your business empire.
